experiences.summary: Owning full-stack delivery of production GTM automation and AI systems — from event-driven backends and AI-powered workflows to the React consoles teams run on every day.

details.headline: GTM automation, production AI, and full-stack ownership
details.overview: Lead full-stack delivery across frontend, backend, and operations — architecting an event-driven GTM automation engine end-to-end across Java, React, and Python, and owning CI/CD across Jenkins and Harness plus AWS, GitHub Actions, and Docker, with production rollout validation through OpenShift Console.

sections.title: GTM Automation & AI Systems
items: Built a real-estate GTM workflow automation engine (Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL) that triggers multi-step workflows from CRM events — automating lead follow-up, task creation, and AI-driven first contact so inbound leads never go cold.
Integrated an AI voice-calling service for automated first-touch qualification, capturing lead intent so the assigned agent walks into the conversation with full context instead of a cold call.

Engineered an HMAC-verified webhook ingestion pipeline against the Follow Up Boss CRM using the inbox pattern — durable storage and dynamic trigger routing turned raw CRM events into a zero-loss source of truth for every downstream automation.

Delivered a full-stack lead-management console (React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query; Spring Boot REST API) giving ops a single view of each lead with cross-linked calls, workflow runs, and activity history.

sections.title: Data Platform & Performance
items: Built an embeddable analytics module with React, Java services, and Redis caching — enabling secure multi-tenant access with SCM-based RBAC across integrated products.
Shipped real-time AI insight streaming with React and Server-Sent Events (fetchEventSource) over Java REST APIs, cutting perceived latency for dashboard users.
Delivered dynamic cascading, multi-attribute filtering and improved chart rendering and personalization — contributing to a 22% increase in user retention.

sections.title: Production Reliability & Observability
items: Diagnosed and resolved a production-critical Java deadlock using Datadog traces and log correlation, then added circuit-breaker and retry logic adopted across all external integrations — zero recurrence after the fix.
Sustained production reliability through on-call rotations, root-cause analysis, and documented recurring fixes.
Led an architecture refactor toward production-grade standards, using metric-driven PBIs to validate reliability and performance gains.

sections.title: CI/CD, Platform Operations & Collaboration
items: Owned CI/CD across Jenkins and Harness pipelines and automated containerized deployments with Docker and GitHub Actions on AWS — consistent, rollback-ready releases.
Used OpenShift Console to monitor deployment health, inspect pod and runtime behavior, and validate production rollouts after pipeline runs.
Mentored interns on full-stack fundamentals, code quality, and Git workflows; collaborated across engineering and product in Agile/SCRUM delivery cycles.

details.closing: Shipped production GTM automation and AI systems end-to-end — turning ambiguous business problems into reliable software with measurable reliability and retention gains.
